name: Provodov (Czechia)
description: Five horizontal stripes of navy blue, white, navy blue, white and navy blue in the ratio 1:1:5:1:1, with three yellow flowers with red centres on stalks in the middle stripe.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 26 May 2011 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
